FROM pois p

ORDER BY p.geometry::geography <-> (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Wildlife West Nature Park%' AND region_name ILIKE '%Edgewood%' AND region_name ILIKE '%NM%' LIMIT 1)
LIMIT 1;
